successors.name: Sokoto Caliphate
successors.text: Zazzau (Zaria) and its dependencies: the page names only the Zaria, Sabon Gari, Giwa and Soba local-government areas of Kaduna State; the whole Kaduna region stands for the kingdom at confidence 1

ledger.x: 1805: the kingdom ends; the Zazzau Emirate continues under the Sokoto caliphate (and "British forces led by Frederick Lugard took the city in 1901", no month).

wars.name: Fulani jihad in Zazzau
wars.outcome: "In 1805 it was captured by the Fulani during the Fulani Jihad."

certainty.note: The page gives no outline; the whole Kaduna region is a stand-in.
